__baseline_prompt__.text: A music-themed photograph with a reference-guided musician performing music. Use the supplied reference for visible facial proportions and the dark chin-length bob with airy fringe. A solo pianist is seated at a black grand piano in a modest, empty recital room, repeating the ending of a difficult passage before the audience arrives. Her attentive three-quarter face is visible above the keyboard, her eyes lowered toward her hands, with relaxed parted lips and a small release of tension in her brow. She wears a soft ivory blouse with an open collar and a charcoal skirt, the loose fabric settling naturally at her seated waist. Her quiet attractiveness comes from her absorbed presence and the ease of her shoulders, illuminated by a tall side window. Both forearms remain traceable from her shoulders through her wrists to her own two hands. Her left fingertips press a small group of lower-register keys while her right fingertips press separated higher-register keys, with the white key fronts and black-key groups clearly visible around each contact. Her wrists hover naturally above the keyboard edge and her elbows have room beside her torso. Her weight rests on the piano bench, her left shoe rests flat on the wooden floor, and her right shoe touches the rightmost sustain pedal beneath the keyboard. The bench seat, both lower legs, the floor contacts and the complete pedal assembly are visible in the open space below the keyboard. A single open score with small pencil markings sits on the music rack, offset so it leaves her face and hands clear. A few empty recital chairs recede behind her. A medium-wide horizontal photograph from the pianist's front-left side, slightly above keyboard level, holds her face, both hand-key contacts and her seated support in one coherent view. Gentle window light and a subdued amber wall lamp reflect softly on the piano rim; natural skin texture, restrained colors, clear musical geometry, and documentary stillness.

literals.u0: In a small sunlit dining room, an adult reads a newspaper at one end of the table. Above the empty seat opposite floats a single white cloud slightly larger than a human head, separated from both table and ceiling. Its edges are irregular and translucent; the tabletop below is dry and the surrounding air is clear. The reader continues an ordinary morning routine. Open space is visible both below and above the cloud.
